description: Department of Forest Conservation - Forest Conservation Ordinance Order Release the Block of the Forest of the Irompaikkulam Reserved Forest From 07.08.2024.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the release of forest lands from reserved status.
